0.original: The nearby Resistance camp has need of help, and Eshana has a mind to send you.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

24.original: Speak with the Resistance captain east of Virdjala.

25.original: Use the Resistance cannon to destroy dharas.

48.original: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, a requessst for help has come from the Resistance camp to the east. They ssseek to cull unruly dharas.

49.original: These creatures feed on rock; if left unchecked, they are liable to cause avalanches, thus endangering travelers.

50.original: Pray make hassste to the camp and report to the Resistance captain. He will furnish you with further inssstructions.

51.original: Ah, you must be the adventurer they sent! You have our thanks.

52.original: As you will have heard, we seek to put down some uncommonly aggressive dharas. And to ensure that they stay down, we will strike their cores with cannon fire.

53.original: At the junction to the north, we've laid a hunk of precious ore which attracts dharas. The creatures will single-mindedly march towards it, thus exposing their vulnerable cores to the cannon we've positioned at the perch nearby.

54.original: Your task is to use the cannon to destroy the dharas before they can reach the ore. Go now, and good luck!

55.original: Use the cannon to destroy the three dharas. You may move the camera as well as zoom in and out. Target the core and fire with <hex:020825E4E95101FF10024804F2022203EE81910248020103FF0E021E021003202F20021E02090303>.

56.original: Do not let the dharas reach the ore, or the mission will end in failure.

59.original: The cannon is positioned at the perch just north of here. Hurry there and use it to destroy the dharas before they can reach the ore!

60.original: You did it! The dharas have all crumbled into the rock whence they came!

61.original: Our friends of the border guard hold you in high esteem, and small wonder. Thank you, adventurer, and please pass my regards to Eshana.

62.original: So the dharas are no more? Excellent work, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. You have done all of us a great ssservice.

63.original: That Resistance camp keeps watch over the route to the Peaks. Though our companies be different, we do not hesitate to cooperate with one another for the common good.

64.original: My thanks again for your help with the dharas. Please pass my regards to Eshana.
